metadata.scope: Development model selection on fixed probes; numerical gains are optimistic and do not establish human likeness. High-pitch follow-up remains failing.
metadata.summarySemantics: summary uses only candidates from the known source engine (4 per arm); unrestrictedSummary selects across all three engines (12 per arm), with no source-engine hint.
metadata.hybridCaveat: Per-engine architecture selection used these same development probes; both summaries are optimistic model-selection results, not independent tests.
